DescribeDetail.description: How much of the catalogue `api.describe` sends (protocol 1.110, ADR-0196).

oneOf.description: Name, scope and effect only.
Also the input and output schema of each selected method.

input_schema.description:
`api.describe` parameters (protocol 1.110, ADR-0196). Both lists select what the
answer covers; when both are empty it covers every method.

namespaces.description: Only the methods of these namespaces (`source`, `scene`, ...).

input_schema.title: DescribeParams

Effect.description:
What a method does to the studio (protocol 1.76, ADR-0052 decision 4). A client
treats a missing or unknown effect as [`Effect::Destructive`]. Without the token
permission "Allow actions that cannot be undone", `live` and `destructive`
methods are refused with `not_permitted`.

oneOf.description: Reads state; changes nothing.

Undoable, or reversed by another call with nothing lost, or only adds a new
file and never replaces one.

Starts or stops what goes out: recordings, streams, the virtual camera, the
replay buffer, a calibration run; switches the output profile.
Removes something outside the undo history.

MethodInfoOwned.description: A method and its scope, owned (for deserializing).

effect.description:
What it does (protocol 1.76); absent from an older server, which a client
treats as `destructive`.

input_schema.description: Schema of the request parameters, when available (protocol 1.108).

output_schema.description: Schema of the successful result, when available (protocol 1.108).

scope.description: The scope it needs; `null` for the handshake.

Scope.description:
One permission. Every method declares exactly one scope (or none, for the
handshake); a call outside the session's scopes returns `scope_denied`.

oneOf.description: Queries, `api.describe`, event subscriptions.

Scene and source changes, capture-target lists, record start and stop with
configured profiles, undo and redo, `ui.*`.

Settings, explicit file paths. Loopback and IPC only, unless the user turned on
"Allow remote admin".
Plugin management. Loopback and IPC only.
Token management. Loopback and IPC only.

Topic.description: An event topic. Subscriptions and the subscriber mask are per topic.

oneOf.description: The program scene's source list (state).
The recording state (state).
The canvas (state).
The settings (state; `admin` is needed to subscribe).
Audio levels (latest value, sampled at the client's rate).
The stream state (state): started, connected, reconnecting, ended.
The scenes, the one on air and the collection's sources (state, protocol 1.6).
The virtual camera, without its counters (state, protocol 1.12).
The replay buffer: armed, what it holds, the last clip (state, protocol 1.27).

The recording state of a canvas other than the main one, one key per canvas
(state, protocol 1.29).

The stream state of a canvas other than the main one, one key per canvas
(state, protocol 1.29).

The monitor output: device, volume, solo, whether it plays (state, protocol
1.30).

Recording protection: disks, lag, memory and alerts (state, protocol 1.49,
ADR-0090).
The calibration run, *Test this computer* (state, protocol 1.55, ADR-0087).
The sync offset measurement (state, protocol 1.66, ADR-0126).
The attribute clipboard (state, protocol 1.68, ADR-0133).
A program change's transition started or ended (protocol 1.81, ADR-0128).

`item.scroll_finished` (protocol 1.94, ADR-0150): a `Once` scroll ended, per
canvas.

One add-on's status, one key per catalog entry (state, protocol 1.90,
ADR-0145).

One group's `group.get` state, one key per scene, group and canvas (state,
protocol 1.111, ADR-0184).

One group's failing rendered occurrences, one key per scene, group and canvas
(state, protocol 1.111, ADR-0193 decision 5).
A group `Once` Scroll run ended, one key per run (protocol 1.111, ADR-0185).

protocol.description: The protocol version the session speaks.
